Customer) Guidelines, 2022 [hereinafter referred as IFSCA (AML,CFT and KYC) Guidelines,/

Certification Course on Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing in the
IFSC" has been developed by the National Institute of Securities Markets (NISM) in
collaboration with the IFSCA Academy. The course is aligned with the IFSCA (AML, CTF

under the Guidelines shall mandatorily undergo the said certification course and they shall
continue to hold the said certification at all times while discharging their responsibilities under
the Guidelines.
